n7ca5ab3427.headline: Ukraine blocks transit of Russian gas to Europe, prompting price hike
n7ca5ab3427.summary: Ukraine has blocked the transit of Russian gas to Europe, a move that prompted a price increase.
n7ca5ab3427.why: Gas transit routes determine supply into Europe, and disruptions to those flows typically lift European gas benchmark prices.
n7ca5ab3427.why_moved: The input reports that blocking Russian gas transit to Europe prompted a price increase, consistent with a reduction in supply on a key route.

n8a2d1f5980.headline: Economy in Counties Trump Won Points to Governing Challenges
n8a2d1f5980.summary: Analysis links Donald Trump's November election victory to anger over post-pandemic price rises for groceries and housing.
n8a2d1f5980.why: Voter sentiment on prices and housing shapes the policy choices and political risks that markets monitor in the United States.

n2f2251ab5b.headline: China's Caixin manufacturing PMI breaks two-month upward streak and slips to 50.5 from 51.5
n2f2251ab5b.summary: China's Caixin manufacturing PMI slipped to 50.5 from 51.5, breaking a two-month upward streak and missing the 51.7 expected by Bankinter.
n2f2251ab5b.why: The Caixin PMI is a widely followed gauge of private-sector Chinese factory activity, and readings near 50 separate expansion from contraction for the world's second-largest economy.

nd229b06274.headline: World Food Prices Dip 2% In 2024: UN Food Agency
nd229b06274.summary: World food commodity prices declined 2.1% in 2024 compared with the previous year, the FAO said. Prices remain considerably higher than before the Covid-19 pandemic.
nd229b06274.why: The FAO food price index tracks global prices for staples such as cereals, oils and dairy, which feed into inflation, farm incomes and food trade across economies.

n9bae3b335a.headline: US trade deficit rises to more than $100 billion
n9bae3b335a.summary: America's trade deficit widened in November to more than $100 billion, as import growth outpaced the uptick in exports, according to government data.
n9bae3b335a.why: The trade balance is a component of US GDP, and a wider deficit can influence growth estimates, currency expectations and Federal Reserve policy outlooks.

n3fba96e0a4.headline: 2025 budget: FG to support farmers with N132bn
n3fba96e0a4.summary: The Nigerian Federal Government has allocated N132bn to support farmers and farming activities in 2025, according to the 2025 Appropriation Bill.
n3fba96e0a4.why: Nigeria is Africa's largest economy, and government spending on agriculture affects food production, rural incomes and inflation. Budget allocations shape fiscal policy and sector investment.

n969bc9a6cb.headline: What influenced the hryvnia exchange rate in 2024 and what are the prospects for 2025 - analysis and forecasts from KYT Group analysts
n969bc9a6cb.summary: Interfax-Ukraine reports that the hryvnia exchange rate faced pressure from a number of challenges in 2024, with KYT Group analysts giving forecasts for 2025.
n969bc9a6cb.why: The hryvnia is Ukraine's national currency, and its exchange rate affects inflation, import costs and foreign investment returns in the country.

n058faf15ea.headline: 'Tinubu's tax reform bills anti-North,' BACCIMA backs Gov Bala
n058faf15ea.summary: The Bauchi State Chamber of Commerce, Industry, Mines and Agriculture (BACCIMA) has given its full support to Governor Bala Mohammed over his statement on the Tax Reform Bill introduced by President Bola Tinubu.
n058faf15ea.why: Nigeria's tax reform bills set the tax framework for businesses and investors, and chambers of commerce often represent business interests in debates over them.

n6806f1e967.headline: ‘Drab’ December caps disappointing year for retailers
n6806f1e967.summary: Shopper visits over the Golden Quarter were down 2.5% on the same period in 2023, according to the BRC-Sensormatic Footfall Monitor, capping a disappointing year for retailers.
n6806f1e967.why: Footfall data is a leading indicator of UK retail sales, which feed into consumer spending, retailer earnings and the wider economy.

n5a3b54b700.headline: MRC Global Announces $125 Million Share Repurchase Program
n5a3b54b700.summary: MRC Global's board authorised a new $125 million share repurchase programme, which expires on January 2, 2028.
n5a3b54b700.why: MRC Global is a Houston-based distributor of pipe, valves and fittings to the energy and infrastructure sectors, and buybacks return capital to shareholders.

n038f12610a.headline: Suspend tax reform bills for wider consultation, NNPP chieftain urges Tinubu
n038f12610a.summary: Deputy National Chairman of the New Nigeria People's Party, Prince Nwaeze Onu, urged President Bola Tinubu to suspend the proposed tax reform for wider consultation.
n038f12610a.why: Tax reform changes government revenue and business tax burdens, which affects corporate earnings and investor sentiment on Nigerian assets.

n2afb5f1503.headline: Argentina’s Central Bank gets US$1 billion repo with five international banks
n2afb5f1503.summary: Argentina's central bank obtained a US$1 billion repo with five international banks. The loan uses BOPREAL dollar-nominated bonds as collateral.
n2afb5f1503.why: Central bank repo facilities add dollar liquidity and affect investor confidence in Argentina's reserves and FX position.

nabadca98ce.headline: Euroseas plans three-vessel Nasdaq spin-off
nabadca98ce.summary: Euroseas plans to spin off three of its older ships into a new company listed on Nasdaq, expecting the separate entities to achieve better valuations.
nabadca98ce.why: Euroseas is a Greek shipping company, and spin-offs are used to separate asset groups so each can be valued on its own.

nd717a086ae.headline: Tax Reform Bill: Demystifying NLC chairman, Joe Ajaero’s call for withdrawal
nd717a086ae.summary: NLC chairman Joe Ajaero has called for the withdrawal of the Tax Reform Bills, which may be passed and implemented in the new year.
nd717a086ae.why: Tax reform changes government revenue and business tax burdens, which matter for investors in Nigerian assets.

n9c881b6119.headline: Trump calls to
n9c881b6119.summary: Trump criticised North Sea wind farms and called for reopening oil production as major oil companies exit the region, with APA Corp planning to leave by 2029.
n9c881b6119.why: North Sea output shapes UK and European crude supply, and producers' exits affect future production volumes.

n510c715711.headline: US Natural Gas and Heating Oil Prices Jump on Cold Snap Forecast
n510c715711.summary: US natural gas and heating oil prices rose sharply on a forecast polar vortex that could bring record-breaking cold weather. Demand expectations drove the rally.
n510c715711.why: Natural gas and heating oil are key winter energy fuels, and cold weather spikes in demand quickly move their futures prices.

impacts.name: US natural gas
impacts.why: A forecast cold snap raises expected heating demand, lifting natural gas prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n510c715711.why_moved: A predicted polar vortex with possible record cold is expected to raise heating demand for natural gas and heating oil.

ne6b35e456a.headline: Two People Claim to Be President of Venezuela – Will US Militarily Intervene?
ne6b35e456a.summary: Two people claim to be president of Venezuela, with a rival inauguration set in Caracas ten days before Donald Trump's US inauguration. The article asks whether the US will intervene militarily.
ne6b35e456a.why: Political instability in Venezuela affects its oil output, sanctions exposure and the value of its sovereign debt, which matter to energy and emerging-market investors.

n5b78ce07a3.headline: New York’s Oil Company Shakedown
n5b78ce07a3.summary: Governor Kathy Hochul signed a law levying a $75 billion fee on the oil industry to address climate change. The fee applies to oil companies operating in New York.
n5b78ce07a3.why: Climate-related fees and levies raise costs for oil and gas producers and can affect their earnings and capital spending.

n146b9cf84f.headline: Subscribers to sue telcos over 100% tariff hike proposal
n146b9cf84f.summary: Subscribers say they are preparing to sue telecom companies over a proposed tariff hike that could double service costs nationwide. The proposal is still at the stage of a proposal.
n146b9cf84f.why: Telecom operators in Nigeria, such as MTN Nigeria and Airtel Nigeria, depend on tariff approvals that directly affect their revenues. Regulatory decisions on pricing are a major factor for the sector's earnings.

nb7ee16e031.headline: Fears of a major rise in energy prices
nb7ee16e031.summary: An increase in European wholesale gas prices has sparked fears of a major surge in residential electricity and energy prices. The concern centres on household energy bills.
nb7ee16e031.why: Wholesale gas prices feed into electricity and retail energy costs in Europe, and they are a key input for power generation and industry.
nb7ee16e031.why_moved: European wholesale gas prices increased, which raised concern about higher residential energy costs in the region.

n4e2f0b7d82.headline: Mexico could once again receive non-Mexican deportees from US, Sheinbaum suggests: Friday's mañanera recapped
n4e2f0b7d82.summary: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum suggested Mexico could once again receive non-Mexican deportees from the United States. She discussed the topic alongside new US tariffs at her press conference.
n4e2f0b7d82.why: Migration and tariff policy between the US and Mexico affect bilateral trade and the outlook for Mexico's economy.

n1c12241c77.headline: ‘Ghana is not broke’ — Nana Akufo-Addo replies critics in final address
n1c12241c77.summary: Outgoing Ghanaian president Nana Akufo-Addo defended his two-term administration's economic record in his final address. He dismissed criticism of the economy.
n1c12241c77.why: Ghana's economic management and public finances affect its sovereign credit and investor sentiment toward West African frontier debt.

n56a6140cfb.headline: Mining in Manchester?: Crypto-currency biz eyes development at city industrial park
n56a6140cfb.summary: An Iowa crypto-mining business is eyeing Manchester, Iowa, as the site for its largest investment yet. The report describes a development at a city industrial park.
n56a6140cfb.why: Crypto-mining firms run energy-intensive data operations, so their site choices affect local power demand and the supply of bitcoin.

n4ae333aea0.headline: Tinubu's 15 percent inflation targets for Nigeria in 2025 unrealistic - Rewane
n4ae333aea0.summary: Bismark Rewane, chief executive of Financial Derivatives, said President Bola Tinubu's 15 percent inflation target for 2025 is unrealistic. The comment addresses the government's disinflation goal.
n4ae333aea0.why: Inflation targets guide monetary policy and the expected path of interest rates and the naira, which matter for investors in Nigerian assets.

n7e08ebc583.headline: JBT Corporation Completes Settlement of its Voluntary Takeover Offer of Marel hf. and Commences Trading as JBT Marel Corporation
n7e08ebc583.summary: JBT Corporation completed the settlement of its voluntary takeover offer for Marel hf. The combined company now trades as JBT Marel Corporation, a food and beverage technology provider.
n7e08ebc583.why: JBT is a US food-processing equipment maker and Marel is an Icelandic food-processing technology firm, so the deal creates a larger global supplier to the food and beverage industry.

n368d392793.headline: NB Lists New 20.707bn Shares On NGX
n368d392793.summary: Nigerian Breweries' allotted shares, totalling 20.707 billion, were formally listed on the daily official list of the Nigerian Exchange Group. The company's legal director and secretary Uaboi Agbebaku confirmed the listing.
n368d392793.why: A listing of new shares increases the free float and share count of a company on the exchange, which matters for investors tracking the Nigerian equity market.

ne867d169fc.headline: Swiss tax free allowance cut from 1 January 2025
ne867d169fc.summary: The tax-free limit for shopping brought into Switzerland fell from CHF 300 to CHF 150 per person per day. The Federal Council decided the cut in October 2024.
ne867d169fc.why: The allowance determines how much VAT-free shopping travellers can bring into Switzerland, affecting cross-border retail sales near its borders.

ne131bc1dff.headline: ‘Drab’ December caps disappointing year for retailers
ne131bc1dff.summary: Shopper visits over the Golden Quarter were down 2.5% on the same period in 2023, according to the BRC-Sensormatic Footfall Monitor. Retailers had a disappointing year.
ne131bc1dff.why: Footfall data indicates consumer spending strength, which matters for UK retailers and the wider consumer economy.

nedcfbf3d35.headline: Donald Trump says UK’s retreat from North Sea oil and gas is a ‘big mistake’
nedcfbf3d35.summary: US president-elect Donald Trump said the UK's retreat from North Sea oil and gas is a big mistake. He also said the government should get rid of windmills in a social media post on British energy policy.
nedcfbf3d35.why: The North Sea is a key source of UK oil and gas production, so changes in British energy policy affect domestic energy supply and the companies operating there.

n9ec1b37949.headline: Tesla annual deliveries fall for first time as incentives fail to drum up demand
n9ec1b37949.summary: Tesla's annual deliveries declined for the first time as incentives failed to boost demand for its vehicles.
n9ec1b37949.why: Tesla is the world's most valuable automaker by market value, and its delivery trends are closely watched by investors in electric vehicles.

impacts.name: Tesla
impacts.why: A first-ever annual fall in deliveries signals weakening demand for Tesla vehicles despite incentives.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n9ec1b37949.why_moved: Annual deliveries fell for the first time despite incentives, pointing to weaker demand for Tesla's vehicles.

n7a80cab285.headline: In Norway, nearly all new cars sold in 2024 were fully electric
n7a80cab285.summary: Nearly all new cars sold in Norway in 2024 were fully electric, according to a Norwegian EV association head. The country is positioned to be the first to nearly eliminate petrol and diesel new car sales.
n7a80cab285.why: Norway is a leading early adopter of electric vehicles, and its sales mix offers a test case for how fast EV adoption can displace combustion-engine cars.

n7da55db109.headline: Why Tesla Stock Is Surging Today
n7da55db109.summary: Tesla stock showed strong bullish momentum on Friday, according to Yahoo Finance. The report gave no specific cause for the move.
n7da55db109.why: Tesla is the world's most valuable electric vehicle maker, and its share price is closely watched as a bellwether for the EV and growth stock sectors.

impacts.name: Tesla
impacts.why: The article reports strong bullish momentum in Tesla shares on Friday.

n72229a9e9d.headline: Sensex Nifty tank nearly 1 pc on selloff in banking IT stocks
n72229a9e9d.summary: Sensex and Nifty settled nearly 1 percent lower as selling pressure hit banking and IT stocks in Mumbai. The indices buckled under the broad selloff.
n72229a9e9d.why: The Sensex and Nifty 50 are India's benchmark equity indices, and banks and IT services are heavily weighted sectors within them.
n72229a9e9d.why_moved: Selling pressure in banking and IT stocks, which carry large weights in both indices, drove the decline.

n4b8fedf883.headline: Map shows congestion pricing will cost up to $27 to drive into Manhattan: Firefighters, teachers and businesses can’t afford it
n4b8fedf883.summary: A map shows Manhattan's congestion pricing could cost up to $27 for drivers entering the area. Business owners warn they will pass the increased costs on to customers.
n4b8fedf883.why: Congestion pricing is a road-use charge that raises transport costs for commuters, businesses and delivery operators in the affected zone.

n672a0739b7.headline: Alibaba quits Sun Art stake for $1.6 billion as it refocuses on e-commerce
n672a0739b7.summary: Alibaba has agreed to sell its majority stake in hypermarket chain Sun Art Retail Group to Chinese private equity firm DCP Capital for US$1.58 billion, as it refocuses on e-commerce.
n672a0739b7.why: Alibaba is a major Chinese e-commerce group, and portfolio disposals like this reflect strategic refocusing on core businesses.

ne19cbcb156.headline: Rupee registers marginal improvement against US dollar
ne19cbcb156.summary: The rupee registered a marginal improvement against the US dollar, settling at 278.56 in the inter-bank market.
ne19cbcb156.why: The US dollar exchange rate is a key gauge of currency stability, affecting import costs and external debt servicing for an economy.

nd840f8fa31.headline: Former crypto executive Do Kwon pleads not guilty in US
nd840f8fa31.summary: Federal prosecutors charge former crypto executive Do Kwon with securities fraud, wire fraud, commodities fraud and conspiracy. Kwon has pleaded not guilty.
nd840f8fa31.why: Do Kwon co-founded Terraform Labs, whose collapsed stablecoin and token ecosystem triggered major losses and regulatory scrutiny across crypto markets.

ncd005298e9.headline: Thai Central Bank Anticipates Steady Economic Growth Despite Uncertainties
ncd005298e9.summary: Thailand's economy is expected to grow 2.7% in 2024 and 2.9% in 2025, driven by tourism, private consumption and electronics exports. The outlook was published by the central bank.
ncd005298e9.why: Thailand's growth outlook shapes investor views on Southeast Asian consumption, tourism and electronics exports.

n801c2592f9.headline: US Approves Sale of Missiles to Japan for $3.64Bln - Pentagon
n801c2592f9.summary: The US State Department approved a possible sale of AIM-120D-3 and AIM-120C-8 air-to-air missiles and related equipment to Japan for $3.64 billion. The Defense Security Cooperation Agency announced the approval.
n801c2592f9.why: Foreign military sales are approved by the US government and benefit US defense contractors that build the equipment. They also reflect deepening security ties between Washington and its Asian allies.

nd4eadce6aa.headline: SBP reserves fall $371m in two weeks
nd4eadce6aa.summary: State Bank of Pakistan reserves fell $371 million over two weeks. The central bank said the reserves were used for external repayment obligations.
nd4eadce6aa.why: The State Bank of Pakistan holds the country's foreign exchange reserves, which back imports and debt payments. Reserve levels are closely watched as a gauge of external financing strength.

n1d912db3bd.headline: Plant-milk packaging company tied to listeria outbreak plans to file for creditor protection  | Globalnews.ca
n1d912db3bd.summary: Joriki, a plant-milk packaging company linked to a listeria outbreak, plans to file for creditor protection. The company has three facilities in Canada and one in the U.S., owned by a subsidiary.
n1d912db3bd.why: Creditor protection gives a financially distressed company breathing room from lenders while it restructures. Product safety incidents can create large liabilities for food producers.

nf75b04263b.headline: SBP, govt urged to lower interest rates
nf75b04263b.summary: Businesses in Pakistan are calling on the State Bank of Pakistan and the government to lower interest rates, as firms struggle with a series of economic challenges.
nf75b04263b.why: The State Bank of Pakistan sets the policy rate that influences borrowing costs for businesses and households across the economy.

n6a53144e9b.headline: Biden blocks sale of US Steel to Japan’s Nippon Steel
n6a53144e9b.summary: President Joe Biden blocked the $14.6 billion sale of US Steel to Japan's Nippon Steel, citing the need for a level playing field, a move likely to strain ties with Tokyo, Al Jazeera reported.
n6a53144e9b.why: US Steel is a major American steelmaker, and Nippon Steel is one of Japan's largest steel producers; the deal was subject to US government review.
n6a53144e9b.why_moved: President Biden blocked the deal citing the need for a level playing field, according to the report, which is likely to roil relations with Tokyo.

nec3150d059.headline: Sugar Advisory Board meeting: Tanveer assures stability in sugar prices
nec3150d059.summary: Pakistan's Federal Minister for Industries and Production, Rana Tanveer Hussain, said on Friday that all necessary measures would be taken to ensure stability in sugar prices.
nec3150d059.why: Sugar is a widely consumed staple, and government policy on its supply and prices affects inflation and the food-processing sector.

ne40dab1f6c.headline: Uraan Pakistan designed to avoid pitfalls of previous initiatives: Ahsan Iqbal
ne40dab1f6c.summary: Pakistan's planning minister Ahsan Iqbal says Vision 2010 and Vision 2025 were derailed by political instability and policy discontinuity. He said Uraan Pakistan is designed to avoid those pitfalls.
ne40dab1f6c.why: Development plans set the long-term policy path for Pakistan's economy, which affects investment in infrastructure and industry. Policy continuity is a key factor for foreign and domestic investors.

ndd6132bb60.headline: S&P/TSX composite rises Friday while U.S. markets see tech-led rally
ndd6132bb60.summary: Canada's main stock index rose Friday, led by technology and telecom stocks. U.S. markets also rallied, with the Nasdaq gaining 1.8 per cent, according to the report.
ndd6132bb60.why: The S&P/TSX Composite is the benchmark index for Canada's main exchange, covering the country's largest listed companies. Its moves reflect Canadian equity sentiment and sector performance.

nbad1050be1.headline: Brookfield delays sale of London's Citypoint office tower, source says
nbad1050be1.summary: Brookfield has delayed the sale of its Citypoint tower in London after bids fell short. The property manager must extend debt repayments, a source familiar with the matter said.
nbad1050be1.why: Brookfield Corporation is a global alternative asset manager with large real estate holdings, so weak office sale prices affect its property valuations and financing.

nc99aedb2d9.headline: President Biden Blocks Japan's Nippon Steel From Acquiring US Steel
nc99aedb2d9.summary: The US President vetoed Nippon Steel's $15 billion takeover of a US steel company over national security issues.
nc99aedb2d9.why: This decision impacts US-China-Japan trade relations and US steel industry investments.

nf220b722a6.headline: South Korea's impeached president defies warrant in hourslong standoff
nf220b722a6.summary: South Korean investigators left the president’s residence after a six-hour standoff during which he defied their attempt to detain him amid political crisis.
nf220b722a6.why: The political crisis in South Korea involves the impeachment of two heads of state, impacting government stability and investor confidence.

ndbec1c4df4.headline: Naira weakens to 1,541/$
ndbec1c4df4.summary: The Nigerian naira weakened to N1,541.36/$ on the first trading day of the year, reflecting currency market pressures.
ndbec1c4df4.why: Currency fluctuations impact Nigeria's inflation, import costs, and foreign investment flows.

impacts.name: Nigerian Naira
impacts.why: Naira's weakness affects Nigeria's import costs and inflation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n49aabac493.headline: Oil Prices Rise at the Start of 2025 as Demand Optimism Prevails
n49aabac493.summary: Oil prices increased in Asia as market sentiment turned positive on expectations of stronger economic growth and oil demand in 2025.
n49aabac493.why: Rising oil prices reflect expectations of higher global demand, impacting energy markets and inflation outlooks.

n4cf3a36ecb.headline: Sensex Slips 300 Points To 79,650 As IT, Pharma, And Financials Drag Markets Down
n4cf3a36ecb.summary: Indian stock markets opened lower, with the Sensex falling 300 points as IT, pharma, and financial sectors dragged markets down.
n4cf3a36ecb.why: India's stock index movements reflect investor sentiment and economic outlook, influencing foreign and domestic investment flows.
